rules.statement: Timer value increases by CFG0.step (modulo 2^64) once every CFG0.prescale + 1 cycles; prescale 0 gives a tick every cycle.
The first tick shall come no later than CFG0.prescale + 1 + 4 cycles after the write response.
Tests write CFG0 and TIMER_V_* only while CTRL.active_0 = 0; behaviour after such a write while active is not checked.

rules.condition: mtime >= mtimecmp holds and timer is active, after a write of 1 to INTR_STATE0.IS_0
rules.statement: INTR_STATE0.IS_0 shall read 1 within 4 cycles after a write of 1 to it.

rules.condition: condition mtime >= mtimecmp becomes true by a tick
rules.statement: IS_0 shall be 1 no later than 4 cycles after that tick.

rules.condition: condition becomes true by a register write while active
rules.statement: IS_0 shall be 1 no later than CFG0.prescale + 1 + 4 cycles after the write response.

rules.condition: except in the 2 cycles after IS_0 or IE_0 changes
rules.statement: o_intr_timer_expired shall equal IS_0 AND IE_0.

rules.condition: after a write to COMPARE_LOWER0_0 or COMPARE_UPPER0_0 leaves mtimecmp > mtime and it stays so
rules.statement: IS_0 shall be 0 and the interrupt deasserted within 4 cycles.

rules.condition: after a compare write mtime >= mtimecmp still holds
rules.statement: IS_0 shall be 1 again within 4 cycles; an intermediate dip is not checked.
Write-only fields read 0, reserved bits read 0 and writes to them have no effect.
INTR_TEST0 reads 0x0 and ALERT_TEST reads 0x8000_0000.

rules.condition: after a write to ALERT_TEST with bit 31 = 0 (regwen cleared until reset)
rules.statement: Regwen reads 0 until reset; a later write of 0x8000_0001 completes with d_error = 0, triggers no alert.

rules.condition: one write of 1 to fatal_fault, no other alert cause, no other such write within 32 cycles
rules.statement: Exactly one o_alert pulse shall occur, no later than 16 cycles after the write response.

rules.condition: fatal_fault writes closer than 32 cycles apart
rules.statement: At least one o_alert pulse and no more pulses than writes shall occur.
Tests do not use the combined write 0x0000_0001; they write 0x8000_0001.
o_alert shall pulse no later than 16 cycles after acceptance, then at least once every 32 cycles until rst_ni is asserted.
The test resets the design.
A write with i_a_instr = 1 is not used.

rules.condition: request to an unmapped offset in 0x000..0x1FF
rules.statement: The slave returns d_error = 1 and changes no register.
Requests at offset 0x200 and above are not used.

rules.condition: byte write (a_size 0, mask 0001, aligned) to CFG0, TIMER_V_*, COMPARE_* or ALERT_TEST
rules.statement: Returns d_error = 1 and changes nothing.

rules.condition: byte write to byte 0 of CTRL, INTR_ENABLE0, INTR_STATE0 or INTR_TEST0
rules.statement: Completes with d_error = 0 and has the effect of the write.
The write succeeds with d_error = 0.
Returns the full register.
Match responses by d_source, use distinct a_source per outstanding request, and do not assume o_a_ready = 1.
Returned value lies between values before the request and after the response.
d_error is correct, d_source echoes a_source, d_size echoes a_size, d_opcode is AccessAckData for Get and AccessAck for PutFullData and PutPartialData.
d_error = 1 is returned.

rules.condition: rst_ni = 0 and first cycle after release
rules.statement: The test bench keeps i_a_valid = 0.
o_d_valid, o_alert, o_alert_integ_fail and o_intr_timer_expired shall be 0.
The pending response is discarded.
o_d_intg_err and o_alert_integ_fail shall be 0 in every cycle.
Reached only by writing the timer value registers while inactive to values near the carry, then counting.
Tests drive i_a_param = 0.
